headline: Economic Development Commission to discuss Westerly State Training Facility tour, Old Tower Hill Road plan, SMART Committee work, and URI Medical School.
summary: The commission will review old business including the Westerly State Training Facility tour and Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan, then take up new business on absorbing SMART Committee work, a future URI Medical School, and collaboration with other town boards. Staff will also update the commission on Planning Department project applications and recurring topics like EDC surveys and the South Kingstown Garden Show.
items: Tour of Westerly State Training Facility - Follow-Up Discussion
Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Follow-up discussion on Council consideration of Form Based Code
Absorption of SMART Committee Work into EDC - Discussion of resuming statistical analysis work formerly delegated to the SMART Committee
Future URI Medical School - General discussion about working with URI
EDC Collaboration With Other Town Boards
Staff update on Lofts at Fairgrounds - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept.
Staff update on South County Commons District 5 Apartments - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept.
EDC Surveys - Discussion regarding survey data collection, results & next steps
South Kingstown Garden Show - Continued discussion of conceptual event
New discussion issues and future agenda items
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI

C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
Presentation by staff of any correspondence issued or received by the EDC since the previous meeting & receipt

by the EDC on any correspondence or comment not specifically referenced in the agenda.

 2. Old Tower Hill Road Neighborhood Plan - Follow-up discussion on Council consideration of Form Based 
Code.

formerly delegated to the SMART Committee. 
 2. Future URI Medical School - General discussion about working with URI. 
 3. EDC Collaboration With Other Town Boards 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities: 
Presentation by staff of any new project applications received by the Planning Department and any activities by 
the Planning Department with potential economic impacts for the town. No action will be taken by the EDC on 
any information presented by staff unless specifically referenced in the agenda. 
 1. Lofts at Fairgrounds - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept. 
 2. South County Commons District 5 Apartments - Preliminary Plan application received by Planning Dept.
